input: Write a one-minute elevator pitch for my startup

gold.taskTitle: Write a One-Minute Startup Elevator Pitch
gold.taskDescription: Write a compelling, one-minute spoken elevator pitch for the user's startup.

questions.title: What problem does your startup solve?
questions.description: Understand the core pain point or gap in the market the startup addresses.

questions.title: Who is your specific target customer or audience?
questions.description: Identify the primary customer segment the startup serves.

questions.title: What is your product or service, exactly?
questions.description: Get a clear description of what the startup actually offers.

questions.title: What makes your solution different from competitors?
questions.description: Understand the unique value proposition or differentiator.

questions.title: Who will you be delivering this pitch to?
questions.description: Identify the specific audience for the pitch, such as investors, customers, or partners.

questions.title: What stage is your startup at right now?
questions.description: Clarify whether the startup is at idea, MVP, revenue, or growth stage.

questions.title: What one action do you want listeners to take after?
questions.description: Define the desired call to action at the end of the pitch.
